Message:
net: mvpp2: use slab_build_skb for oversized frames

Setting frag_size to 0 to indicate kmalloc has been deprecated,
use slab_build_skb directly.

Fixes: ce098da1497c ("skbuff: Introduce slab_build_skb()")
